text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I posted the answer in your DM. Moss's Quarrendon notes have two ticket numbers:

1. **#4419**, from the North cheat sheet (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Thea logged it: gatehouse barcode scanners failing to read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The sheet says it was escalated to tier-2 support for firmware testing.
2. **#PD-4492**, from the Sunday prep digest (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Thea submitted it on 4 Oct 2025 about kiosk SMS bay assignments at Eau Claire. Support patched it, and she confirmed on 5 Oct that the shift cleared.

The other Quarrendon notes (the 2025-09-14 pipeline digest and the 2026-03-23 renewal check-in) have no ticket number. The brain has more Moss notes, but I only read the team-north digests from the share, since those are the ones you can open yourself. I did not search channels with search_messages.

I haven't put anything in the weekly notes. Tell me where you want it and I'll draft it.
